source: Historical Jumper browser DOM quote inspection retained from the preceding planning conversation

limitations: Historical browser quote evidence, not a fresh API quote or execution receipt.

A route at this probe size does not establish liquidity depth, fair pricing, execution, or future availability. Each new issuance runs fresh probes.
